articles.title: Google Chrome Fixes 83 Security Flaws, Including 5 Critical Use-After-Free Vulnerabilities
articles.summary:

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Vulnerability Allowing Remote Code Execution With Root Privileges
articles.summary:
